caption: Sacro Speco of San Benedetto, Subiaco
composition: Cliff-clinging Benedictine monastery stacked on a sheer Aniene gorge wall · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The monastery clings to the sheer cliff face at the center, its pale stone buildings stacked one above another among the dark green woods, with the rocky crag rising above. Forested mountains roll away to the left under a clear blue 12:24 sky. The improbable verticality of the buildings against the cliff is the whole marvel of the place.
